name: sched_setaffinity
synopsis: int sched_setaffinity(pid_t pid, size_t cpusetsize, const cpu_set_t *mask);
description: sched_setaffinity sets the CPU affinity mask for a specified thread, determining the set of CPUs on which it can run. This can improve performance on multiprocessor systems by dedicating CPUs and avoiding cache invalidation costs.

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: The ID of the thread to set affinity for; 0 for the calling thread.

parameters.name: cpusetsize
parameters.description: The length in bytes of the data pointed to by mask.

parameters.name: mask
parameters.description: Pointer to the CPU set structure representing the affinity mask.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: A supplied memory address was invalid.
The affinity bit mask contains no processors that are currently physically on the system and permitted to the thread.
cpusetsize is smaller than the size of the affinity mask used by the kernel (for sched_setaffinity on kernels before Linux 2.6.9).
The calling thread does not have appropriate privileges.
The thread whose ID is pid could not be found.
